entities.summary: The Bibliotheca is a compendium of Greek myths and heroic legends, genealogical tables and histories arranged in three books, generally dated to the first or second century AD. The work is commonly described as having been written by Apollodorus, a result of its false attribution to the 2nd-century BC scholar Apollodorus of Athens.
